stemMd:
Evaluate the following statement using only the passage, choosing an assessment with a sound justification:

At least one member without a financial interest abstained.

options.label: A
options.textMd: True, because no member had a financial interest.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Not deducible: the passage does not settle it.

options.label: D
options.textMd: True: it follows from the passage.

explanationMd: This restates the explicit existence claim and does not depend on identifying that member.

distractorRationale.b: The passage does not support this classification as a contradiction. This restates the explicit existence claim and does not depend on identifying that member.
distractorRationale.c: The supplied conditions do settle the claim. This restates the explicit existence claim and does not depend on identifying that member.
distractorRationale.a: This assessment uses a premise that is contradicted by or absent from the passage. A matching classification with an unsound justification is not correct. This restates the explicit existence claim and does not depend on identifying that member.
